capabilities: convert Markmap Markdown to a CSV file
trigger conversion from the command palette
trigger conversion via a keyboard shortcut
disambiguation: It does not render or preview Markmap mind maps; it only converts the Markdown structure to CSV.
extras: The README references a how-to video and shows input/output examples as code blocks. It notes that another plugin is needed if you want to see the Markmap rendered. Writing is informal and the scope is narrow: headings up to level 2 are supported, with lists used below heading 2.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Markmap-style hierarchical Markdown outline into CSV data.
summary: Converter that exports Markmap mind-map Markdown (headings plus lists) into a CSV file.
